=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:227-313 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The line-by-line shell validator does not normalize backslash continuations, so `coproc` can be split across lines and evade validation or depend on parser error handling.
  WHY: Both reviewers identified the same parser limitation; deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro says current behavior fails closed via `shlex` raising `ValueError` and only misclassifies the rejection reason, while moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 says the split can bypass the dangerous-token check.
- scripts/review_synthesise_smoke.sh:228-229 | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: Multi-line backtick command substitution can evade detection because the checks run per line.
  WHY: A backtick opener and closer on different lines are not seen as one complete construct by the line-by-line scanner.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:948, 1308-1309 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The extra `sed 's/\\n/\n/g'` transform can corrupt literal `\n` text in the extracted issue body.
  WHY: `jq -r` already decodes JSON newline escapes, so the additional substitution can turn legitimate backslash-n text into actual newlines.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:170-260, 220-260 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Deleted-file evidence lookup can miss when the consolidator cites a path variant such as a `b/` prefix.
  WHY: `parse_patch` keys deletions by the old path, but `verify_already_fixed()` looks up the evidence path verbatim, so a mismatch reports `does-not-support` for a genuinely deleted file.
- scripts/validate_process.sh:1285-1414 | severity=medium | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: When `_safe_target` rejects the manifest path, wrapper scripts are still copied even though the manifest JSON is skipped.
  WHY: That leaves `validation/tests/` with incomplete materialization, so downstream tooling loses the manifest-to-wrapper traceability the function is supposed to preserve.
- scripts/review_run_judge_interim.sh:265-340 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The cleanup trap can leave behind a stale temp directory if `rmdir` cannot remove the root, though the guards suppress any failure.
  WHY: The source explicitly says no runtime failure is expected and the leftover directory is benign because runner temp space is ephemeral.
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1268-1294 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The worktree cleanup trap may run after a partially created worktree, but `git worktree remove --force` should still clean it up.
  WHY: The source says the `|| true` guard makes this fail-safe and no practical issue was identified.
- .github/workflows/implement.yml:337-413 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The "Resolve checkout ref" step name is misleading because it always returns the default integration ref and never resolves a baseline branch.
  WHY: The source says the separation is correct and tested, but the step can still block for up to 14 seconds on API retries.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
